narration:
For {identical_months} month you and the ghost were the same life, and in month {fork_month} you chose {real_choice} while the ghost took {ghost_choice}.
In month {layoff_month}, at the layoff, the ghost had {layoff_net_worth_gap}.
The ghost's Safety ended {safety_gap}, and it could last less long with no pay.
The ghost's Life ended {life_gap}, and it was a little further from only getting by.
By month {end_month}, the ghost had {net_worth_gap}.
